title: Monster for Cyberspace
summary: A client for cyberspace.online, the retro text-only social network
description: Chat in cIRC rooms, read and send C-Mail, follow the Feed, Guilds, People and Notes on cyberspace.online, all from the CardputerZero's keyboard. Uses the device's Wi-Fi. Sign in with your cyberspace.online account; settings and backups stay on the device.
